subject.title: doctor --fix migrates codex/gpt-5.5 to openai/gpt-5.5, then Codex app-server startup times out on 2026.6.1

question: Should OpenClaw solve this combined report by accepting a retained-route doctor migration policy for ambiguous legacy Codex state, and is the separate initialize/startup timeout repair required before this issue can close?
rationale: Current main still implements the migration shape, and the proposed repair changes compatibility-sensitive doctor behavior rather than a purely mechanical bug fix; automation cannot choose the long-term legacy Codex migration contract or proof bar for maintainers.

options.title: Accept retained-route migration plan and review startup fix
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93180 for the doctor policy side, then decide whether https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89442 is needed to cover this issue's startup-timeout smoke failure before closing.

options.title: Require one combined fix path
options.body: Keep this issue open until a single merged path proves both doctor migration safety and post-migration Codex app-server smoke success on an installed setup.

options.title: Choose unconditional canonicalization
options.body: Reject retained legacy Codex routes as a policy direction and keep this issue open for a different migration proof or user-facing recovery design.

recommendation.title: Accept retained-route migration plan and review startup fix
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93180 for the doctor policy side, then decide whether https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89442 is needed to cover this issue's startup-timeout smoke failure before closing.

likelyOwner.reason: The product decision is centered on the legacy OpenAI Codex doctor-only and provider-identity unification behavior that steipete authored and is adjacent to the app-server harness ownership history.
